ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Pluto

t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Move your body first thing in the morning, even if it is only a ten-minute walk.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Help someone quietly, without them knowing it was you.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Share a project of yours with someone who can help.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Ask for an honest opinion from someone you respect.

t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between Mars and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.
